combination.label: Combination · docetaxel Day 1 and steroid premedication

medicines.name: Dexamethasone premedication
medicines.dose: 8 mg orally twice daily for 3 days
medicines.timing: Start the day before docetaxel; at least 3 doses before treatment
medicines.note: Source docetaxel premedication. If missed, consultant may consider 20 mgIV immediately before; not an automatic substitution. Do not duplicate with antiemetic steroid.

additional_support: Consider primary G-CSF prophylaxis; determine need and timing from individual infection risk and local policy.

Low-risk antiemetic reference: dexamethasone 8 mg on Day 1 and as-needed rescue according to NCIS/local policy. The docetaxel premedication is already a steroid course: reconcile into one prescription.
Monitor FBC before each cycle and around nadir; fever needs prompt assessment.
Hypersensitivity, fluid-retention and extravasation precautions; assess neuropathy, mouth and skin toxicity.

combination.label: Combination · nintedanib Days 2–21
additional_support: No routine oral antiemetic prophylaxis in minimal-to-low pathway; prescribe as-needed treatment after interaction/QT/constipation review.
Give an early diarrhoea action plan with oral hydration and prescribed anti-diarrhoeal treatment; ongoing/severe symptoms need assessment and possible interruption.
Nintedanib is not taken on docetaxel Day 1. No double dose after a missed capsule.
Review P-gp interactions, liver tests, BP, bleeding, renal status, surgery/wound healing and contraception.

continuation.label: Nintedanib-only continuation · continuous twice daily
additional_support: No routine oral antiemetic prophylaxis in minimal-to-low pathway; prescribe as-needed treatment after interaction/QT/constipation review.
Give an early diarrhoea action plan with oral hydration and prescribed anti-diarrhoeal treatment; ongoing/severe symptoms need assessment and possible interruption.
Continuous nintedanib includes Day 1 of every 28-day cycle. No docetaxel steroid premedication or automatic chemotherapy G-CSF course applies in this phase.
Review P-gp interactions, liver tests, BP, bleeding, renal status, surgery/wound healing and contraception.
